architectural_units.name: User
architectural_units.description: A user is any individual or entity that interacts with the system, can be both a donor and a company.

architectural_units.name: Security Service
architectural_units.description: Security Service (Traefik) functions as a reverse proxy and load balancer, managing HTTP and HTTPS request routing.

architectural_units.name: System Service
architectural_units.description: System Service (Next.js) serves the web application using React and interacts with the database and external services.

architectural_units.name: Data Service
architectural_units.description: Data Service (PostgreSQL) provides the relational database for storing application data.

architectural_units.name: Traefik
architectural_units.description: Traefik is a modern reverse proxy and load balancer designed to manage incoming and outgoing HTTP and HTTPS traffic.

architectural_units.name: Next.js
architectural_units.description: Next.js is a framework for building web applications that offers additional structure, features, and optimizations.

architectural_units.name: PostgreSQL
architectural_units.description: PostgreSQL is the relational database used to store application data.

architectural_units.name: Docker
architectural_units.description: Docker manages the execution of containers for the services.

architectural_units.name: Prisma
architectural_units.description: Prisma is an ORM tool used to simplify database access and management.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: Amazon S3 is used for cloud storage to store and retrieve files.

architectural_units.name: Stripe
architectural_units.description: Stripe is integrated to handle payments and subscriptions.

architectural_units.name: Google Analytics
architectural_units.description: Google Analytics is implemented to track and analyze site traffic.

architectural_units.name: Sentry
architectural_units.description: Sentry is used to track and manage errors in the application.

architectural_units.name: Brevo
architectural_units.description: Brevo is used to create, send, and schedule emails.

Security Service (Traefik) functions as a reverse proxy and load balancer, managing HTTP and HTTPS request routing. [...] Traefik gestiona el tráfico hacia los servicios internos (System Service y Data Service).
System Service (Next.js) [...] Se comunica con el servicio de base de datos PostgreSQL (Data Service) utilizando Prisma como ORM.

System Service (Next.js) [...] Interactúa con varios servicios externos para funcionalidades específicas: [...] Autenticación: Utiliza Google para la autenticación de usuarios. [...] Almacenamiento en la nube: Utiliza Amazon S3 para almacenar y recuperar archivos. [...] Procesamiento de pagos: Integra con Stripe para manejar pagos y suscripciones. [...] Análisis: Implementa Google Analytics para rastrear y analizar el tráfico del sitio. [...] Monitoreo de errores: Utiliza Sentry para rastrear y gestionar errores en la aplicación. [...] Correo Electrónico: Se conecta a Brevo para crear, enviar y programar correos electrónicos.
Data Service (PostgreSQL) [...] Se comunica directamente con Prisma para gestionar las consultas de la base de datos.
